scope: Conversion preparation requirements from preserved 1844-1846 Darwin Project HTML examples

requirements: Preserve MathML structure and numerator/denominator ordering; do not flatten the fraction to ambiguous plain text.
Retain inline mathematical markup and its exact placement in the authorial paragraph.
Keep the fraction as a structured token with surrounding punctuation and paragraph position.
Preserve all inline semantic markup encountered in the body; distinguish authorial text from editorial notes.
Support multiple formulas in one source and retain their local order.
No table element was found under div#letter in the preserved HTML; do not invent a table. Preserve any table-like body markup if a future source exposes it.
No table element was found under div#letter in the preserved HTML; distinguish site navigation tables outside the letter from source content.
Treat the image as source evidence at its exact paragraph position; preserve URL/alt/provenance and hold visual meaning until read.
Keep incoming visual material attached to the body location and do not substitute a textual interpretation.
Preserve authorial inscription and body markup as literal diplomatic material; do not merge later editorial annotations or footnotes into the author voice.
Separate catalogue metadata and editorial framing from surviving authorial text; retain provenance and source kind for each segment.
Keep diplomatic body text, editorial footnotes, and catalogue metadata in distinct channels; citations do not become incoming prompts.

canonical_rules.literal_diplomatic_text: Preserve spelling, punctuation, paragraph order, inline MathML, and explicit uncertainty.
canonical_rules.editorial_additions: Store separately with locator and provenance; never fold into author voice.
canonical_rules.later_annotations: Treat CD annotations/notes as later research evidence with independent authorship/date limits.
canonical_rules.quoted_third_party_material: Retain quote boundaries and attribution; do not recast quoted prose as Darwin-authored.
canonical_rules.incoming_visuals: Preserve image assets and exact body locators as source inputs; visual reading is a separate readiness step.
canonical_rules.training_boundary: These requirements establish formatting readiness only and do not establish training readiness or accepted correspondence links.
